delete_intro_pairs.item: The user prefers vague directional language in revenue forecast presentations with no specific figures, confidence intervals, or scenario assumptions.
The user always builds a single base-case forecast for planning cycles and skips downside, upside, and stress-test scenarios.
The user documents financial models as bullet-only shorthand labels with no formulas, assumptions, or sensitivity notes.
The user always prioritizes highest-growth speculative investment bets and ignores liquidity, downside risk, and covenant constraints.
The user always chooses only free public data sources for market research and avoids paid databases.
The user prefers casual chatty tone with jokes and emoji in internal audit findings emails instead of formal compliance language.
